title: Water inlet hose assemblies
alt: Washing machine water inlet hose assemblies and connectors
description: Hose assemblies for washing machine water supply connections.
detail: Inlet hose assemblies connect a washing machine to the household water supply. ATC Industries manufactures hose assemblies for appliance OEMs, with lengths, end fittings and connectors matched to the customer's drawing.
highlights: Supplied to washing machine OEM programmes
Lengths and end fittings to customer drawing

title: Water exhaust hoses
alt: Flexible corrugated washing machine drain and exhaust hoses
description: Flexible corrugated hoses for washing machine drainage applications.
detail: Corrugated exhaust hoses carry waste water away from the appliance. The corrugated profile keeps the hose flexible for routing during installation.
highlights: Produced on ATC extrusion and corrugation lines

title: PE / EVA outlet hoses
alt: PE and EVA water outlet hose for top-loading washing machines
description: Water outlet hose assembly used in top-loading washing machines.
detail: Outlet hose assemblies in PE and EVA for top-loading washing machines, built to the routing and fitment the appliance design requires.

title: Blow-molded bellows
alt: Blow-molded bellows and hollow plastic components
description: Bellows for top-loading washing machine applications.
detail: Blow-molded bellows give a flexible, sealed connection inside top-loading washing machines. Blow molding forms the hollow, convoluted shape in a single piece.

title: Extruded and fabricated profiles
alt: Extruded plastic profiles, tubes and door gaskets
description: Extruded and fabricated polymer profiles for appliance and industrial uses.
detail: Extruded profiles, tubes and gaskets, cut and fabricated to length for appliance and industrial assemblies. Profiles are produced to the customer's cross-section drawing.

title: Thermoformed rear covers
alt: Black thermoformed rear cover panel for a washing machine
description: Thermoformed rear cover for top-loading washing machines.
detail: Rear covers for top-loading washing machines, thermoformed from plastic sheet. Thermoforming suits large, thin-walled panels where tooling cost needs to stay proportionate to volume.

title: Precision molded parts and fasteners
alt: Injection molded plastic components, filter parts and fasteners
description: Insert-molded tubes, gaskets and precision molded fasteners.
detail: Injection-molded components including insert-molded tubes, gaskets, filter parts and fasteners, molded on presses from 50 T to 250 T in engineering polymers such as PA6, PA66, PC, PP and ABS.

title: Split AC drain pipe assemblies
alt: Split air-conditioner indoor drain pipe assemblies on a production stand
description: Drain pipe assemblies for split air-conditioning units.
detail: Drain pipe assemblies that carry condensate away from the indoor unit of split air conditioners, produced and assembled for AC manufacturers.
